_hand: HAND-WRITTEN — the one registry entry that does NOT come from daedalus's Apply flow. Same entry schema as one apps.json value, read by daedalus.nix through platform/lib/registry-lib.nix — with ONE difference: where a registry entry carries a full `hostname`, this file carries `hostLabel`, and daedalus.nix joins it to the site's baseDomain before the mapper or the manifest see it, so the engine never spells a domain. daedalus is declared here rather than in the registry because an Apply that broke its entry would take down the interface you would use to undo it. Editing this file IS the workflow; rebuild to apply. The label is `daedalus-app` rather than the derived `daedalus`, which a host may reserve (fleet.reservedLabels) for a page it publishes elsewhere, such as the project's landing page.

notes.app: The control plane itself. Declared by hand in stacks/daedalus/self.json rather than in the registry: an Apply that broke this entry would take down the interface you would use to undo it.
notes.source: The engine itself: one image from the repository's Dockerfile. A host runs its bundle, published or built on the box from the locked engine source (fleet.daedalus.source); the host that develops the engine runs it in dev mode over its checkout, where saving a file is the whole deploy.
